about.pageTitle: About International Association for the Defense of Flowers - Mission & Purpose
about.pageDescription: Learn about the mission to preserve floral and pollinator memory, unite communities through nature's beauty, and create a global archive of biodiversity.
about.heroTitle: What is the International Association for the Defense of Flowers?
about.heroSubtitle: The digital garden where nature meets technology
about.missionText1: Our association is the digital garden of the planet, where flowers and pollinators become ambassadors of Earth's biological and cultural diversity.
about.missionText2: We preserve the floral and pollinator memory of all nations, bringing together science, art, and education in one digital space.
about.missionText3: It's a platform that unites communities, institutions, and individuals through the beauty and fragility of nature.
about.missionStatement: Connect communities, institutions, and individuals through the beauty and knowledge of flowers and pollinators, inspiring environmental awareness and fostering international cooperation to protect our natural heritage.
about.purpose1: Build a universal floral and pollinator archive for everyone
about.purpose2: Share environmental education through digital, artistic, and learning tools
about.purpose3: Create a global community of guardians for biodiversity
about.purpose4: Support transparency and positive impact, helping vulnerable communities
about.quote: AquaMundi is not just a website: it is a living mantle that unites science, culture, and hope, where each flower and pollinator remind us that the Earth blossoms in diversity.

landing.title: International Association for the Defense of Flowers
landing.subtitle: Proveneya & Nahiara
landing.description: A literary saga and transmedia ecosystem that unites 195 national flowers and their pollinators through innovative formats: an illustrated book, an engaging card game, a comprehensive 3D floral archive, and interactive robotic exhibitions.
landing.bookTitle: Nahiara & the Guardians of the Flowers
landing.bookDescription: An illustrated literary journey through the world's most beautiful flowers
landing.gameDescription: Interactive gameplay celebrating global floral diversity
landing.archiveDescription: National flowers in high-quality glTF/STL formats
landing.exhibitionDescription: Museographic experiences bringing flowers to life
landing.visionText: Connecting cultures through the universal language of flowers, raising awareness about biodiversity, and fostering institutional and editorial collaborations worldwide.
landing.copyright: © 2025 International Association for the Defense of Flowers Proveneya & Nahiara
landing.association: International Association for the defence of flowers Proveneya & Nahiara
landing.storyText: Nahiara & the Guardians of the Flowers is more than just a book—it's a gateway to a magical world where every national flower tells a story. Through this interactive digital experience, you can explore the 195 flowers that inspired the tale and discover the real-world connections between cultures, nature, and conservation.
landing.continueJourneyText: The book is just the beginning. Explore the complete digital ecosystem of Nahiara's world.
landing.interactiveArchiveText: Explore all 195 national flowers in stunning 3D detail. Click on any flower to learn about its cultural significance, conservation status, and role in Nahiara's story.
landing.completeSagaText: Discover the full literary universe including the illustrated card game, robotic exhibitions, and educational resources that bring Nahiara's world to life.
landing.joinCommunityText: You're now part of a growing community of readers, educators, and conservationists who believe in the power of storytelling to connect cultures and protect biodiversity. Share your experience, connect with other flower guardians, and help us spread Nahiara's message around the world.
landing.shareExperienceText: Help us spread Nahiara's message! Share your thoughts about the book, tag us in your posts, and connect with other readers around the world.
